materialized_views.name: document_uploaded_daily_mv
materialized_views.grain: day x doc_type x capture_mode x scan_mode x device_type x os x destination

metrics.name: avg_retry_count_by_doc_type_capture_mode
metrics.pm_question: What is the retry_count distribution by doc_type and capture_mode? Which combination has the worst friction?
metrics.formula: avg(retry_count) and quantiles of retry_count grouped by doc_type, capture_mode
metrics.notes: avg via avgMerge(retry_avg_state); MV keeps sum+count for weighted rollups. Quantile of retry_count not in MV (needs raw table).

metrics.name: threshold_crossed_share
metrics.pm_question: What share of uploads have is_crossed_failed_attempt_threshold = 1? Does it predict abandonment?
metrics.notes: rate = sumMerge(threshold_crossed_state)/countMerge(uploads_state). Abandonment prediction is cross-table (out of MV scope).

metrics.name: avg_retry_by_scan_mode_passport
metrics.pm_question: Do scan_mode=auto vs manual differ in retries for passport documents?
metrics.formula: avg(retry_count) grouped by scan_mode, filtered to passport doc_types
metrics.notes: Filter doc_type IN ('passport_front','passport_back') at query time; scan_mode + doc_type both in MV grain.

metrics.name: upload_failures_by_platform
metrics.pm_question: Which platform (iOS vs Android) has more upload failures?
metrics.formula: count(*) and avg(retry_count) and sum(is_crossed_failed_attempt_threshold) grouped by os / device_type
metrics.notes: os and device_type both in MV grain; 'failure' proxied by retries + threshold-crossings.

metrics.name: doc_volume_vs_payment_conversion_by_destination
metrics.pm_question: Which destinations need the most doc types? How does doc volume compare to payment conversion?
metrics.formula: count(*) by destination (doc volume); conversion = payment events / upload cohort by destination (cross-table)
metrics.notes: Doc-volume-by-destination is served by uploads_state in the MV; the payment-conversion comparison requires a join to a payment/pay_now spec table and is OUT of scope for this MV.
